description: tools/upsert-task.ts:24-35 returns { ok, action, changed, editedRanges, sync } but the architecture text says 'Returns { ok, action, fieldsChanged[], editedRanges[], filePath }'. The missing filePath and fieldsChanged[] fields are minor in absolute terms (skills can compute them) but the plan explicitly committed to the richer shape, and they would help operator-driven flows see which fields were touched without re-reading the mutator's editedRanges labels.
suggestedFix: Extend the return value to { ok, action, changed, fieldsChanged: editedRanges.map(r => r.label), editedRanges, filePath: context.config.dataFile, sync }. fieldsChanged is just a label projection so it does not require new mutator output. Add a test that asserts the new fields.
